# Lazarus

Lazarus is an open-source, local-first AI desktop application for Windows and Linux. It supports local chat, coding tools, image and video workflows, voice, and user-configured local or remote providers.

Lazarus does not operate a hosted model catalog, inference account, paid model API, or cloud memory-sync service. Local inference runs on the user's device. If a user configures a remote provider, requests go to that provider under its terms.
